description: UniFi OS Server (UniFi OS core, UniFi Network and the UniFi identity services) as one pod with one container per service, using external PostgreSQL, MongoDB and RabbitMQ.

derper: Tailscale's DERP relay for tailnets (Tailscale or Headscale), relaying traffic between nodes that cannot connect directly, with STUN, TLS on 443 as nonroot. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
